headline.zh-CN: 历史问题上下文与制作记录权限
headline.en: Historical issue context and production-record permissions

summary.zh-CN: 母带问题反馈保留跨版本、跨制作周期的未解决问题，已解决记录折叠展示；平台内的母带与终审问题、评论及附件按制作参与者权限提供。
summary.en: Mastering feedback retains unresolved issues across audio versions and workflow cycles and folds resolved history; in-platform mastering and final-review issues, comments, and attachments are limited to production participants.

description.zh-CN: 未解决问题默认展开，已解决和内部结案记录可按需展开。来源标识区分源版本与母带制作轮次，历史未解决问题保持清晰可读。
description.en: Unresolved issues are expanded by default, while resolved and internally closed records can be expanded when needed. Provenance distinguishes source versions and master delivery cycles, and historical unresolved issues remain clearly readable.

description.zh-CN: 问题列表可选择全部版本或当前版本，审听中的 A/B 对比选择保持独立。主波形只显示对应音频的标记，历史问题通过详情中的原版本预览查看；音频不可用时仍保留文字和讨论。
description.en: Issue lists offer all-version and current-version filters independent of A/B listening selections. Main waveform markers match their audio, historical issues use original-version detail previews, and text and discussions remain available when audio is unavailable.

title.zh-CN: 明确新问题的版本归属
title.en: Explicit version context for new issues

description.zh-CN: 新问题明确绑定当前源版本，历史对比期间保持只读标注。提交后恢复可见筛选并定位新问题，避免问题保存后被旧版本条件隐藏。
description.en: New issues explicitly target the current source version, while historical comparisons keep annotation read-only. Submission restores a visible filter and focuses the new issue so an older-version selection cannot hide it.

title.zh-CN: 制作问题与成品试听分开授权
title.en: Separate production records from final-audio access

description.zh-CN: 平台内的母带与终审问题、评论和附件仅向相关曲师、专辑管理者及指定母带工程师开放，历史记录、站内通知和活动记录遵循同一访问范围。普通成员可继续试听已完成曲目的最终母带，同行评审问题权限保持原有规则。已经配置的专辑 Webhook 保留现有推送设置。
description.en: In-platform mastering and final-review issues, comments, and attachments are available to credited composers, album managers, and the assigned mastering engineer. History, in-app notifications, and activity records follow the same access boundary. Ordinary members retain final-audio access for completed tracks, and peer-review permissions stay unchanged. Configured album webhooks retain their existing delivery settings.
